summary.body:
Greptile Summary

The PR pins Fastify as a submodule, updates setup documentation, and substantially expands the standalone blast-radius demo with guided review, hop controls, richer diffs, tooltips, and review state. - Adds a pinned Fastify submodule and aligns setup instructions with it. - Reworks the architecture visualization and code-diff experience. - Adds guided-tour, help, keyboard-shortcut, and edge-inspection UI, but some new interactions lack implementations. - **Downstream impact:** no `demo-repo/*` service is directly affected; the impacted standalone surface is the repository-root `blast-radius.html` demo documented by `setup.md`.

Confidence Score: 3/5

The PR should not merge until the undefined edge-tooltip and help/keyboard handlers are implemented because multiple newly advertised demo interactions currently fail. Hovering graph edges or clicking help controls reaches undefined functions, while every keyboard shortcut shown by the new modal lacks an event handler. **Files Needing Attention:** blast-radius.html

Important Files Changed

 | Filename | Overview | |----------|----------| | blast-radius.html | Major standalone-demo rewrite; edge hover and shortcut/help interactions are currently broken by missing handlers. | | .gitmodules | Registers the Fastify repository as the submodule backing the demo. | | fastify | Pins the Fastify submodule to the log-controller demo revision. | | setup.md | Replaces manual Fastify cloning with submodule initialization and documents the pinned checkout. |
